register.labelZh: GATHER 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: gather around 和 gather round 可以描述人們走近某位說話者、某件物件或某項活動,並聚成一群。；gather something in 可以描述在下雨、天黑或儲存之前收好水果或農作物。；gather up 和 gather together 適合用來談論收拾個人物品、玩具、文件、袋子和工具等物件。；你可以分辨 GATHER 是描述人們聚成一群、收割農作物,還是收拾零散物品。
register.summaryEn: Gather around and gather round help you describe people moving close to a speaker, an object or an activity. Gather something in can describe collecting fruit or crops before rain, darkness or storage. Gather up and gather together are useful for belongings, toys, papers, bags, tools and other objects. You can recognise whether GATHER describes people forming a group, crops being collected or objects being tidied.
